goal: Verify and close out the OrchestrationApi gRPC-gateway rebuild (Runtime as gRPC server wrapping IChatClient/Ollama, OrchestrationApi as thin HTTP-to-gRPC gateway) and the artifacts/ folder sprawl cleanup, then commit the now-clean, build-verified structure.

steps.action: Root-cause and clean stray artifacts/bin and artifacts/obj folders (188 unrelated project outputs) caused by plugins/dotnet-skills sample/test projects lacking their own Directory.Build.props, whose builds were redirected upward via UseArtifactsOutput/MSBuild directory walk-up; confirm zero git impact (folder was fully untracked).

Verify ProjectName.Runtime gRPC server wiring: Grpc.AspNetCore package + Directory.Packages.props pin, Protos/runtime.proto compiled with GrpcServices=Both, builder.Services.AddGrpc(), app.MapGrpcService<RuntimeChatService>().

Verify ProjectName.OrchestrationApi gRPC client/gateway wiring: Grpc.AspNetCore + Grpc.Net.Client packages, ProjectReference to ProjectName.Runtime (source of the generated RuntimeChat.RuntimeChatClient), AddGrpcClient<RuntimeChat.RuntimeChatClient>, RuntimeGatewayService registered and exposed via GET /api/chat with RpcException-to-HTTP-status mapping; verify ProjectName.AppHost wires WithReference(runtime) / WithReference(ollama) / WithReference(modelOrchestrator) so Aspire service discovery resolves the gRPC endpoint.
Run dotnet build ProjectName.slnx -m:1 after terminating any locked AppHost/child processes; confirm 0 errors.

Commit and push the verified working state: never-committed core build files (Directory.Build.props, Directory.Build.targets, Directory.Packages.props, global.json), the new ProjectName.OrchestrationApi project, the new plugins/pmcro plugin, and the modified Runtime/AppHost/ServiceDefaults/solution files that make the gRPC gateway path function end to end.

success_criteria: artifacts/bin and artifacts/obj contain only ProjectName.AppHost, ProjectName.OrchestrationApi, ProjectName.Runtime, ProjectName.ServiceDefaults outputs
dotnet build ProjectName.slnx -m:1 succeeds with 0 errors
ProjectName.OrchestrationApi exposes GET /api/chat backed by a gRPC gateway (RuntimeGatewayService) to ProjectName.Runtime's RuntimeChat gRPC service, which serves responses via IChatClient/Ollama
ProjectName.AppHost wires explicit service references (WithReference) so Aspire service discovery resolves projectname-runtime for the OrchestrationApi gRPC client
All verified structural changes are committed to git and pushed to origin
out_of_scope: HttpStandardResilienceOptions 30-second timeout root-cause investigation (user: 'no bug, it runs')
Decision on splitting pmcro/dotnet-skills plugin marketplaces into separate repos
name_rationale: Directly names both threads this cycle closes: the gRPC gateway rebuild and the artifacts/ sprawl root-cause cleanup.
